name: Darkmantle
summary: A small aberration that drops onto prey and smothers it in magical darkness.

actions.name: Crush
actions.onHit:
and the darkmantle attaches to the target. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the darkmantle had {ref:glossary/advantage} on the attack roll, it covers the target, which has the {ref:condition/blinded} condition and is suffocating while the darkmantle is attached in this way.

While attached to a target, the darkmantle can attack only the target but has Advantage on its attack rolls. Its {ref:glossary/speed} becomes 0, it can't benefit from any bonus to its Speed, and it moves with the target.

A creature can take an action to try to detach the darkmantle from itself, doing so with a successful {dc=13} Strength (Athletics) check. On its turn, the darkmantle can detach itself by using 5 feet of movement.

actions.name: Darkness Aura
actions.text: Magical Darkness fills a 15-foot {ref:glossary/emanation} originating from the darkmantle. This effect lasts while the darkmantle maintains {ref:glossary/concentration} on it, up to 10 minutes. Darkvision can't penetrate this area, and no light can illuminate it.
